Now thoroughly and completely freaked out, I run to my bathroom to check. No flickering. Am I going crazy?

As I'm thinking of running back to my computer to try again, I feel a solid thump behind my eyes. In the next blink, I'm surrounded by words, articles; media of all sorts. Voat was displayed around me, like a hologram that definitely could not exist, we couldn't have developed it this early... Or could we have?

I let my mind wander, losing myself in the nearly infinite amount of data the Internet has to offer, forgetting I was sitting in the cold bathroom tiles in my shared college dorm bathroom.

"Dude, you're freaking us out... snap out of it," are the first words I hear, bringing me back from the wild expanse. I had learned so much. About myself, about the world, about every topic that every person had ever thought of. "Uh, where are you going, are you sure you're okay? Somethings up with your eyes." one of the many faces staring at me quipped as I tried to leave.

"Finding them," I said as if that were all the words I needed. I sidestepped past them and was on my way, only one thought in mind.

Finding them
